elaine (product): Quick sync — we need a compact edge-case inventory for generation APIs to finalize PRD scope for Q3 prioritization. Focus: streaming behavior, truncation semantics, token limits, retry/idempotency, and fallback rules. Add cases + acceptance criteria.

mike (eng): I'll start a draft list. planning to include for each: trigger, observable, desired API surface, AC, and test harness.

stella (sr-eng): Initial items from runtime side:
- streaming cut mid-token (kernel ends while token partial)
- network disconnect during stream (client reconnect/resume)
- token budget exhausted mid-response (stop vs truncate)
- model variant fallback (latency/cost-triggered)
- retries causing duplicate outputs (exact vs approximate dup)
- structured output (JSON) truncated -> parse errors

raj (pm): Customers asking for 2 concrete things: deterministic truncation behavior (banking + audit) and explicit error codes for token-limit events so they can instrument.

mike (eng): Proposed categories + short ACs:
1) Mid-token cutoff:
   - Trigger: streaming worker killed or preemption.
   - Observable: last event ends with incomplete token (non-whitespace suffix) or websocket closes.
   - API surface: final event type 'truncated' with fields: text, tokens_consumed, resume_token (optional).
   - AC: Client receives a well-formed 'truncated' event within 500ms of kernel preemption; text must be UTF-8 and self-consistent (no half-utf8).

2) Network disconnect + resume:
   - Trigger: client TCP/WSS disconnect mid-stream.
   - API surface: resume endpoint POST /v1/resume with resume_token + idempotency-key.
   - AC: If resume_token valid and model variant available, server streams remaining output; if not, server returns canonical 409 with reason 'resume_unavailable'.

3) Token budget exceeded mid-generation:
   - Trigger: request hits per-request or account token limit.
   - API surface: 413 or 429 with body {"error_type":"token_limit","tokens_used":N}. For streaming, final event 'token_exhausted'.
   - AC: Token-limit responses must include numeric tokens_used and allowed_max if applicable.

4) Model fallback (cheap/fast fallback):
   - Trigger: primary model fails latency or OOM.
   - API surface: metadata events note fallback_started/fallback_completed with model ids and cost delta.
   - AC: Fallback path must preserve semantic retry idempotency and not change schema; post-hoc quality regression alert if fallback changes top-k outputs > 10%.

5) Structured output truncation:
   - Trigger: JSON schema generation gets cut.
   - API surface: send partial_json:true and final 'truncated' reason. Provide last_good_parse_offset if calculable.
   - AC: Consumers must be able to detect invalid JSON and receive a stable flag to trigger local fallback parsing.

6) Retry duplication & idempotency:
   - Trigger: client retries after timeout.
   - API surface: requests accept Idempotency-Key header. If same key seen: server returns same final result or canonical error.
   - AC: With identical idempotency-key, server must not double-charge tokens and must return consistent outputs 99% of the time for deterministic model variants; non-deterministic variants documented.

stella (sr-eng): Adding runtime nuance: resume_token should encode model_version + kv_cache_cursor + rng_seed (if available). If rng_seed missing, mark resume_best_effort.

mike (eng): Small example of streaming wire events for truncation/resume (for API doc):
```
event: data
data: {"type":"partial","text":"The quick brown fox jump"}

event: data
data: {"type":"truncated","text":"s over the lazy dog","tokens_consumed":412,"resume_token":"r_7bX...","reason":"preemption"}
event: done
```

raj (pm): For prioritization: recommend we split into M1 (must-have) and M2 (nice-to-have). M1 = token-limit canonical errors, idempotency-key behavior, obvious streaming truncate signal. M2 = rich resume with seeded RNG, fallback quality metrics. Thoughts?

thomas (sre-bot): SRE notes — monitoring & SLIs to add: fallback_rate_per_model, resume_success_ratio, token_exhausted_count, truncated_stream_rate. Alerts: resume_success_ratio < 95% over 5m -> page. :rotating_light:

mike (eng): Tests: unit tests for event formatting, integration burn-in with simulated preemption (kill -9), chaos tests for mid-stream disconnect, e2e with customers who care about deterministic truncation.

elaine (product): Good. Quick AC checklist I want in PRD:
- Clear error codes (413/429/409) and truncated/fallback event types documented
- Idempotency rules defined with examples
- Resume semantics: when server can guarantee exact continuation vs best-effort
- Metric list and alert thresholds
- Customer-forward examples (cURL & minimal client resume example)

mike (eng): I'll push an API proposal in this thread by EOD. Stella will list exact resume token schema. Raj can fold into roadmap and propose M1/M2 for the backlog grooming.

elaine (product): Action items: mike -> API proposal (EOD); stella -> resume token schema + test plan (tomorrow AM); raj -> synthesize M1/M2 and customer ask mapping (tomorrow). I'll draft PRD section and ping legal for redaction policy notes. Thanks. :thumbsup:
